title: NAFEMS LE10 thick plate
sentence: LE1's elliptic membrane extruded into a 3D plate under uniform pressure — a 3D solid benchmark.

expected.quantity: σ_yy at D on the upper surface

theory: LE10 is LE1's section as a $0.6\,\mathrm{m}$ thick plate under $1\,\mathrm{MPa}$, clamped at the outer rim. The target $\sigma_{yy} = -5.38\,\mathrm{MPa}$ is on the upper surface at D, so it is a bending stress: it needs enough elements through the thickness, which is why the sweep uses four quadratic layers.
